title: improv·artist · spiritual (Hilma af Klint)
mutation_directive: improv artist: spiritual via Hilma af Klint

improv_extras.practice: esoteric geometry; spirals, mandalas, color-coded cosmology; visions made diagrammatic

v1.feedback: The concentric-ring mandala of Lucy copies with color-coded spiritual layers is a legit af Klint interpretation — the gold-rose/ultramarine/sage/mauve palette reads as intentional cosmology, not arbitrary. Two improvements: the spiral and breathing motions are nearly invisible (spiralSpeed 0.04, breathe amplitude 0.02) — double both so the 'living diagram' quality is perceptible without scrubbing the timeline; and the piece would feel more diagrammatic (closer to af Klint's actual paintings) if you added faint geometric overlay lines — concentric circles or radial spokes connecting the ring copies via a second draw call with GL_LINES — right now it's figurines-in-a-circle rather than a painted vision-diagram.

v2.feedback: The mandala layout with concentric rings of scaled Lucy figures is a genuine interpretation of af Klint's diagrammatic cosmology — the ring structure, color-coded palette (gold-rose/ultramarine/sage/mauve), and geometric overlay circles all land. Two issues: the top-down camera at distance 85 makes the figures read as abstract dot clusters rather than recognizable silhouettes — pulling the camera closer or tilting to ~30° elevation would let the Lucy forms register as figurative within 2 seconds. The counter-rotating rings and breathing are tasteful but the spoke lines add visual clutter without earning their presence; either make them pulse with the breathing cycle or drop them entirely. Consider giving the center copy a slight upward scale bias so the spiritual 'crown light' effect has a stronger focal anchor.
